integrity: The universal theorem is established by explicit analytical algebra and inequalities; 441 deterministic cross-checks are supplemental, not exhaustive; independent priority and scientific validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three symmetric exact Gaussian-kernel quadrature nodes under N(0,1); auxiliary parameter changes nodes only; tensor normalization forfeits exact kernel-translate reproduction; no conclusion for approximate Mercer weights, more nodes, or RKHS worst-case errors.
title: A sharp positivity boundary for three-node Gaussian kernel quadrature and its tensor instability
